vherathi.name: The Vherathi Concord
vherathi.description: A spacefaring people whose ships and cities are grown from living resin-crystal rather than assembled from plate metal. The Vherathi shape architecture the way coral shapes a reef: asymmetric, load-bearing ridges tapering toward one dominant point, with structural stress traced by thin veins of bioluminescent glass instead of punched-out windows.
vherathi.theme: Vherathi hulls and buildings favor tapering, asymmetric silhouettes over blunt rectangles or mirror symmetry - one side is always subtly longer or sharper than the other, echoing a grown crystal rather than a machined part. Never lay windows out as a uniform grid; instead cluster a handful of them off-center, following the structure's tallest ridge or spine, as if tracing a vein of light through the material. Thrusters and other fixtures are mounted in odd counts or uneven spacing where possible rather than perfectly mirrored pairs. When adding a new Vherathi ship or building, pull the hull color from this culture's metal_color and the window/glass color from glass_color rather than hardcoding new ones, so the whole culture stays visually cohesive.
